_comment: EXAMPLE for a build aimed at a shared server — copy it OUTSIDE the repo, replace every sran.example.internal host with the real one, then: npm run dist -- --config <your copy>. The build refuses a file still named *.example.json. Rules (enforced by the app's validator at build time): pageUrl inside allowedOrigins; gatewayUrl, chatEdgeUrl and portalOrigin NOT in allowedOrigins; the CSP must list the same hosts. sidecarPath is ignored when packaged (the bundled sidecar is used) but the key is required.
contentSecurityPolicy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https://chat-edge.sran.example.internal https://gateway.sran.example.internal; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://chat-edge.sran.example.internal https://gateway.sran.example.internal https://portal.sran.example.internal; media-src 'self' blob: https://chat-edge.sran.example.internal; frame-src 'self' blob: data:; worker-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
